node.statement: Use 1.1.5 to weaken the three C_hat-bounds from 1.1.6 to C_ch*q, C_ch*s, and C_ch*s, and append the strict inequality C_ch*s < 1. Existence, uniqueness, the displayed definition of f_V, membership in calU, and C^1 chart coverage are unchanged. Since W and all algebraic inputs were arbitrary, universal generalization together with the constants chosen in 1.1.1 proves the full root contract.
